disclaimer: This file is data, not investment advice. It contains no recommendation to buy or sell anything.
whatThisIs: Convertible bond (CB), bond-with-warrant (BW) and exchangeable bond (EB) issuance filings from DART (Financial Supervisory Service), for Korean listed companies. 5,084 rows: CB 4,324 · BW 332 · EB 428.
whatThisIsNot: Not investment advice or a recommendation.
Not all 46 DART fields. We publish the columns that carry value; the rest is in the raw DART filing (rcept_no links to it).

Not a single instrument. CB, BW and EB are different legal instruments; instrument_type tells them apart. strike_price_krw / strike_ratio_pct / strike_window_* normalize three differently-named DART fields (conversion for CB, exercise for BW/EB) into one column because they serve the same economic role — see the note on this file’s builder script.
Not proof a refixing floor is missing when refix_floor_price_krw is blank for an EB row — EB has no such field at all (see refix_floor_note).
source: DART (Financial Supervisory Service) — cvbdIsDecsn (convertible bond), bdwtIsDecsn (bond with warrant), exbdIsDecsn (exchangeable bond) resolution-to-issue APIs, full history (2010–present) swept 2026-09-09

columns.name_en: English company name as filed with DART.
columns.filing_id: DART receipt number (rcept_no). Look up the full 46-field filing with this.
columns.instrument_type: CB (convertible bond), BW (bond with warrant), or EB (exchangeable bond).
columns.instrument_kind_ko: Instrument description as filed, original Korean (e.g. registered/unregistered, secured/unsecured, public/private placement).
columns.total_face_value_krw: Total face value of the issue, Korean won.
columns.strike_price_krw: Price per share to convert (CB) or exercise (BW/EB) into equity, Korean won.
columns.strike_window_start: First date the conversion/exercise right may be used, ISO 8601.
columns.strike_window_end: Last date the conversion/exercise right may be used, ISO 8601.
columns.refix_floor_price_krw: Floor price below which the strike price cannot be refixed downward, Korean won. Blank for EB — see refix_floor_note.
columns.refix_floor_note: Explains a blank refix_floor_price_krw. "not applicable" for every EB row (the field does not exist for exchangeable bonds); blank otherwise (CB/BW report a value or explicitly "-", both preserved as blank here, not 0).
columns.private_placement: "private" or "public", from the DART issuance-method field.
